title: Too many windows? See your desktop in 1 second 🖥️ #Shorts
description:
Buried under a pile of open windows? One shortcut hides them all instantly and shows your desktop.

⌨️ Windows: Win + D
🍎 Mac: F11 or Cmd + F3 (on some Macs Fn + F11)

Press Win + D again to bring all your windows back.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
